title: A2UI Template Conformance Test Suite Schema

name.description: Unique name of the test case.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this test case asserts.

action.description: The template engine action being tested.

templates.description: List of template definitions registered with the processor.

template.description: Single template definition registered with the processor.

instance_id.description: Target component instance ID for expansion.

template_id.description: Identifier of the template being expanded.

base_catalog.description: Optional base catalog schema provided to processor.

catalogs.description: Optional catalogs schema provided to processor.

expect.description: Expected result matching the action return value.

expect_error.description: Expected error category and error substring.
